cohort: A 37-year-old primigravida with type 1 diabetes mellitus
finding: This case report highlights the importance of glycemic control using an insulin pump and maternal blood pressure control in a pregnant woman with pregestational diabetes mellitus and pregnancy-induced hypertension for favorable maternal-fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed at 38 gestational weeks, resulting in a live fetus with normal weight.
